remarks:
Discover the perfect blend of privacy and convenience with this beautiful 6-acre parcel just outside the Village of Albion. Situated on a desirable corner lot with 217 feet of frontage along Rt 31A, this property offers endless possibilities for your dream home, hobby farm, or recreational retreat.

The land features a scenic mix of partially cleared and wooded areas, providing both open space and natural privacy, along with a charming pond that adds to the property’s peaceful setting. Enjoy the best of country living while remaining just minutes from the Village of Albion’s shops, restaurants, and everyday amenities.

Electric and public water are available at the road, making this an ideal opportunity to bring your vision to life with ease.

Don’t miss your chance to own a versatile piece of land in a prime location!
